title: My Friend's Dog
text:
My friend has a dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very happy. Every morning, my friend takes Max for a walk in the park. Max needs food and water every day.

Max also likes to play with a red ball. My friend gives him a bath once a week. When Max is sick, they go to the vet. The vet helps Max feel better. Everyone loves Max.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
How does the friend most likely feel about Max?
What can we guess about Max's life with his friend?
options: He lives alone in the park

vocabulary.definition: a short trip taken on foot
washing the body or a pet in water

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşımın bir köpeği var. Adı Max. Max kahverengi ve çok mutlu. Her sabah arkadaşım Max'i parkta yürüyüşe çıkarır. Max'in her gün yemeğe ve suya ihtiyacı var.

Max ayrıca kırmızı bir topla oynamayı sever. Arkadaşım onu haftada bir kez banyo yaptırır. Max hastalandığında veterinere giderler. Veteriner Max'in kendini daha iyi hissetmesine yardımcı olur. Herkes Max'i sever.
